sourceNote: ステラミラクル: MEASURED by pokemon-infomation.com across 1,000 aggregated boxes (30,000 packs). Their per-BOX figures: SR(ポケモン) ~50.0%, SR(サポート) ~30.0%, SAR ~20.0%, UR ~10.0%; AR 3枚確定; RR 4-5枚; ACE SPEC 1枚確定; one SR-or-better per box with ~10% of boxes carrying two. Mapped to this catalog's tiers: ultra_rare takes the whole SR band (50+30=80%/box), special_illustration_rare the SAR, hyper_rare the UR, illustration_rare the guaranteed 3 AR, double_rare the 4-5 RR (4.5 used), ace_spec_rare the guaranteed ACE SPEC. Rates come from ポケゲトちゃんねる (pokemon-infomation.com), which aggregates real box-opening tallies from card shops and individuals — the closest thing Japanese sets have to a primary study, since neither The Pokemon Company nor any English source publishes Japanese odds. Confidence is MEDIUM: the sample is large and the methodology is consistent across sets, but the tallies are not independently auditable. Per-pack probabilities are the site's per-BOX figures divided by this box's 30 packs. NOTE ON GUARANTEES: per-box guarantees (3 AR/box, 1 ACE SPEC/box, ~1 SR-or-better/box) are FOLDED INTO the slot rates rather than modelled as engine floors — a floor attaches to a PRODUCT, so a single-pack product would inherit the whole box's guarantee and read absurdly positive. A box's EV already reflects every guarantee.
